provenance: Example fixtures for Feature Kickoff. They stand in for Confluence pages, GitHub repositories, vendor API docs and the pinned standards registry until those readers are built, and sit behind the same API contract. Every name, page id and commit is illustrative.

prds.title: PRD — Instant credit transfers in the retail app
prds.author: R. Diallo
body: ## Summary
Retail customers in the Netherlands and Germany can send SEPA Instant credit transfers from the web and mobile app.
Funds reach the beneficiary within ten seconds, at any time of day.
## Context
This is a new customer-facing journey; today customers can only send standard SEPA transfers.
Payments are initiated by the customer in the bank's own app. No third-party provider is involved.
## Features
- Send an instant transfer to a new or saved beneficiary
- Fall back to a standard transfer when the beneficiary bank cannot receive instant payments
- Show the final status of the transfer on the confirmation screen
## Acceptance criteria
- A transfer of up to 100,000 EUR to a reachable bank completes within 10 seconds.
- When the beneficiary bank is unreachable, the customer is offered a standard transfer before anything is debited.
- The customer sees Completed, Rejected or Pending on the confirmation screen.
- The confirmation screen meets WCAG 2.2 AA.
## Dependencies
- Uses the payment-order-service to create instant orders (POST /payment-orders/instant).
- Uses the beneficiary-service to check reachability (GET /beneficiaries/{id}/reachability).
## Data
Transfers carry payment data and the customer's IBAN.

prds.title: PRD — Account information API for regulated third parties (UK)
prds.author: M. Okonjo
body: ## Summary
Regulated third-party providers (TPPs) can read UK customers' account and transaction data through a new Account Information API.
## Context
This is a new external API and a new trust boundary.
Customers authorise access during the TPP's redirect flow; the authorisation screens are out of scope for this PRD and the API has no UI of its own.
## Features
- List the accounts a customer has consented to share
- Read balances and transactions for a consented account
- Revoke a consent from the TPP side
## Acceptance criteria
- A TPP with a valid consent can list the customer's accounts.
- Reading transactions for an account outside the consent returns 403.
- A revoked consent stops all access within 1 minute.
- Every request is authenticated with FAPI-compliant mTLS and signed request objects.
## Dependencies
- Uses the consent-service to validate consents (GET /consents/{id}).
- Uses the account-service to read balances (GET /accounts/{id}/balances).
- Uses the transaction-service to read transactions (GET /accounts/{id}/transactions).
## Third parties
- Ledgerly (launch partner, account aggregator)
## Data
Responses carry account data and personal data (PII).

prds.title: PRD — Clearer wording on the transfer confirmation screen
prds.author: T. Verhoeven
body: ## Summary
Update the wording on the mobile transfer confirmation screen in the Netherlands app so customers understand when a transfer is pending.
## Context
This is a copy change only; no logic changes.
## Acceptance criteria
- The pending state reads "On its way — usually within a day".
- The text fits on a 320px-wide screen without truncation.
